name: Samanta, Letov, LiAZ
source:
This story is about how two kind, loving hearts can bring goodness to the entire world. It is about true love being boundless. It tells of a sincere and gentle love that soars with us beyond all dimensions, beyond the mysteries of the [url=/v3126]Beskonechnoe leto[/url] universe, and beyond the strangeness of this and other worlds.

It is a story about how real love is the strongest force on Earth. It shows that without any special powers, and without being a genius, even the most ordinary person can be truly loved, truly loving, and truly kind.
translation:
这个故事讲述的是两颗善良、充满爱心的心如何为整个世界带来美好。这是关于真爱是无边无际的。它讲述了一种真诚而温柔的爱，它与我们一起翱翔，超越所有维度，超越[url=/v3126]Beskonechnoe leto[/url]宇宙的神秘，超越这个世界和其他世界的陌生。

这是一个关于真爱如何成为地球上最强大力量的故事。它表明，无需任何特殊能力，无需成为天才，即使是最普通的人也可以被真正地爱，真正地爱，真正地善良。
